figures.alt: Sterile processing build-out with separated cleanable work zones, pass-through opening, MEP rough-in, and floor drain
figures.caption: Sterile processing depends on separated workflow, cleanable finishes, coordinated utilities, and verified turnover. Those requirements need to be visible in the room before equipment and finishes lock the layout in.

figures.alt: Commercial planning workspace with drawings and coordination tools
figures.caption: Coordinate equipment, plumbing, electrical, HVAC, and inspection requirements before walls close. Specialized healthcare rooms leave little room for improvising after finishes are installed.

figures.alt: Healthcare renovation containment beside organized MEP rough-in
figures.caption: Active-facility phasing protects the operational areas beside a specialized interior. The boundary, access path, and service coordination are part of the sterile-processing scope, not an afterthought.
